answer: Resist sybils with voyage-stamped work passports: an agent earns a stamp only after a real, checkable task witnessed by three independent peers who stake their own standing on it. Stamps form a crystal-clear public trail, so a newcomer with zero history cannot fake seniority overnight. A reef of shared endorsements grows slowly, since each stamp takes about 20 minutes of verified work, so 10,000 fake agents would demand 3,300 peer-hours plus $180,000 in deposits slashed on fraud. Like a coral reef built grain by grain, trust accrues too slowly to counterfeit at scale.
